## 你想解决什么问题 / Problem

这个功能要解决什么痛点？你现在是怎么 workaround 的？

What problem does this solve? How are you working around it now?

## 你想要的方案 / Proposed Solution

你希望怎么做？

What would you like to happen?

## 替代方案 / Alternatives

你考虑过其他方案吗？

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered?

## 备注 / Additional Context

还有什么要补充的？

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
